Hi Ben / Camila,

Thanks for the packet so far. A few clarifications before we can begin formal validation:

1) SOC2: a PDF or link to the auditor's report (redacted is fine). If not available, provide the date of last audit and the responsible auditor.
2) Architecture: diagram showing VPC peering, KMS usage, and whether any customer data leaves the region.
3) Billing: provide proposed SKU names, short descriptions, and unit semantics. Example: "redwood-inference.tku-1000: Per 1k tokens generated".
4) Listing: we need 1 hero screenshot (1200x628), 2 product screenshots (800x600), short summary (<=300 chars), and 3 feature bullets.

DocuSign: We'll send a marketplace listing agreement template after the validation packet is accepted. The fastest path is to include all artifacts in a single zipped "evidence packet" and upload to our partner console link (we provided in an onboarding email).

If you can target providing a consolidated packet by 2026-09-25 we can prioritize review on Sep 28. Otherwise, the next available review slot will be Oct 12.

Regards,
GCP Marketplace Partnerships
